title: Enhance object form and field types documentation with interactive examples
body:
- [x] Analyze current documentation coverage for all field types
- [x] Add missing field type examples to object-form.mdx (password, auto_number, summary, object, vector, grid)
- [x] Add comprehensive field configuration examples (validation, conditional visibility, groups)
- [x] Add more realistic use case examples (registration, settings, product forms)
- [x] Add visual examples showing form layouts (vertical, horizontal, grouped)
- [x] Add examples of field interactions and dependencies
- [x] Verify examples are consistent with actual implementation
- [x] Test documentation examples for syntax correctness
- [x] Create dedicated object-field.mdx page with interactive field type documentation
- [x] Add interactive previews for all 29 field types using InteractiveDemo component
- [x] Update navigation to include new object-field page
- [x] Add interactive demos to all form examples in object-form.mdx
- [x] Address code review comments (select options format, validation property, onSuccess callbacks)
- [x] Remove redundant JSON code blocks (InteractiveDemo has built-in code viewer)
- [x] Remove Field Type Examples section from object-form.mdx (moved to object-field.mdx)

## Summary

Successfully enhanced ObjectForm and field type documentation with comprehensive examples and interactive previews covering all 29 supported field types.

### Phase 1: Enhanced Existing Documentation

**Files Modified:**
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-form.mdx` - Added 586 lines with detailed field examples
- `docs/reference/field-types-examples.md` - Added 572 lines with advanced form examples
- `docs/reference/field-types.md` - Updated field type categories

### Phase 2: Created Interactive Field Types Page

**Files Added/Modified:**
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-field.mdx` **(NEW)** - Dedicated field types documentation page with:
  - 29 interactive field type demos using InteractiveDemo component
  - Each example includes live preview + JSON schema configuration
  - Organized by category (Text, Numeric, Boolean, Date/Time, Selection, Contact, File/Media, Relationships, Users, Location, Computed, Advanced)
  - Comprehensive field type summary table with use cases
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/meta.json` - Added object-field to navigation

### Phase 3: Added Interactive Form Demos

**Files Modified:**
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-form.mdx` - Added 5 interactive form demos:
  - Initial demo - User form with validation
  - Contact Form - Live preview of contact creation form
  - Custom Field Layout - Field grouping demonstration
  - Conditional Fields - Conditional visibility example
  - Complete Product Form - Comprehensive product form with multiple field types
- Added Action Callbacks documentation section explaining onSuccess callback formats (JSON vs TypeScript)

### Phase 4: Cleanup and Optimization

**Files Modified:**
- `content/docs/plugins/plugin-object/object-form.mdx` - Removed redundant content:
  - Removed duplicate Field Type Examples section (663 lines) - now in dedicated object-field.mdx page
  - Removed JSON code blocks after InteractiveDemo components (demos have built-in code viewer)
  - Added link to ObjectField Types page in Related Components
  - Reduced file from 1161 to 500 lines for better maintainability

### Code Review Fixes

- Fixed select options format in grid columns to use proper object structure ({label, value})
- Removed unsupported validation property from form schema examples
- Corrected all select options to consistently use {label, value} format throughout
- Added clarification documentation for action callbacks

### Coverage & Quality

- **Coverage:** All 29 field types with detailed examples and interactive previews
- **Interactive Demos:** 34 live previews (29 field types in object-field.mdx + 5 form examples in object-form.mdx)
- **Validation:** All syntax checks passed (streamlined code blocks, 34 interactive demos)
- **Quality:** Examples follow consistent patterns, real-world use cases, and TypeScript interface compliance
- **Maintainability:** Removed 663 lines of redundant content, cleaner documentation structure

### User Experience Improvements

1. **Dedicated Field Types Page**: All field types now have their own documentation page (object-field.mdx) for easy reference
2. **Interactive Previews**: Each field type AND form example can be tested live in the browser with built-in code viewer
3. **No Redundancy**: Removed duplicate JSON blocks since InteractiveDemo component shows code automatically
4. **Quick Reference**: Summary table for all field types with categories and use cases
5. **Better Organization**: Clear separation between form examples (object-form.mdx) and field type reference (object-field.mdx)
6. **Learning Friendly**: Real-time previews help users understand field behavior and form patterns
